title: Who was in the early Ellington band
summary: Scott and Albertson recall the early lineup of Bubber Miley, Tricky Sam, Greer, Guy, Braud and Hardwick.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Getting back to Duke, can you --

Yeah, and myself, at the time. He hadn't gotten the great big band that he has now, because I heard his son's band last year down at 12th Street, that big school, in the auditorium. Dolby, yes, he had --
I don't mind, because I still have a long way to go.
You remember who else was in the
Yeah. Was it Toby and Sonny?
And Sonny, the guitar player. And Braut on bass, of course, Duke on the piano. And we just had -- that was all, at that time.
Fred Guy, Sonny Grier, Braut on bass, Bubba and --
Tricky Sam was on trombone. Yeah.

Uh-huh. Now, we made records, started making records like that, yeah. Of course, in later years, he changed. Men died or left, like that. All the bands have to change the men, yeah, different reasons.
